text.p: Bangladesh on Tuesday appointed one minister, three state ministers and two deputy ministers, officials said.
Syeda Sajeda Chowdhury was appointed as minister. A senior member of the ruling Awami League, she lost in the June 12 election but was named an MP from the reserve parliamentary seats for women.
The state ministers are Dr M. Amanullah, Talukder Abdul Khaleque and Dr Mohiuddin Khan Alamgir. The new deputy ministers are Dhirendra Debnath Shambhu and Jinnatunnesa Talukder.
President Shahabuddin Ahmed administered the oath of office to the new ministers, whose portfolios have yet to be announced.
Alamgir is a career bureaucrat and had been secretary to Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina until Tuesday.
State Minister for Law and Parliamentary Affairs Abdul Matin Khasru was promoted to the rank of full minister and given the same portfolio, the officials said.
Tuesday's appointments expanded the cabinet to 31 ministers.
